::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 22nd [1860-1890]  
**Manuscript:** MS Columbia University Library, New York:  Ray Collection.
:::

My dear [Mrs Baker](people/person_2075.qmd)
Here is your New Zealand paper. I am very sorry I have not been able to use it in the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd), but I get more and more in arrears of MS, and am shocked at the way thinks [sic] lie by 

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Black-edged paper.
